name: motion-dolly-zoom
title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo)
description: Chủ thể giữ nguyên cỡ trong khi phông nền co giãn mạnh, tạo cảm giác chóng mặt, bất an.

moworks.author: moworks

options.layers: selector of the layers (the subject at depth 1)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Subject layer keeps its screen size while the camera moves z 0 -> +300 (perspective 1100 px) and background layers scale 1 -> 0.6, 2000 ms easeInOutCubic; per-layer scale compensation from each layer's distance. camera/dolly-zoom solves the focal length per frame but only on its own content. (A small canvas demo that scales every layer by 1 - 0.6 x depth shrinks its subject too: follow the recipe.) Params: duration (2 s) · z (+300) · scale nền (0.6) · perspective (1100 px).
